## 2. Detailed Product Specifications, HS Codes & Container Loading

### 2.1 Vietnamese Cassia Cinnamon (`Cinnamomum cassia` / `Cinnamomum loureiroi`)
- **Product URL**: https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/cinnamon.html
- **HS Codes**: `0906.11` (Whole/Bark), `0906.19` (Cassia Bark), `0906.20` (Crushed/Ground Powder)
- **Growing Origins**: Yen Bai Province & Quang Nam Province, Vietnam
- **Grades & Cuts Supplied**:
  1. **Tube / Rolled Whole Cassia (`桂通` / `Quế ống`)**: Length 30–45 cm, natural curled cylinder, high oil content.
  2. **Cigarette / Cigar Cinnamon Sticks (`烟仔桂` / `Quế điếu`)**: Precision-cut 8 cm, 10 cm, 15 cm, 20 cm, 25 cm, scraped or unscraped bark.
  3. **Split Cassia (`桂皮` / `Quế chẻ`)**: Clean lengthwise strips, sun-dried on covered floors.
  4. **Broken Cassia / Chips (`桂碎` / `Quế vụn`)**: High-aroma bark pieces for industrial extraction & grinding.
  5. **Pure Fine Cinnamon Powder (`肉桂粉` / `Bột quế`)**: 80–120 mesh, 100% pure ground cassia bark with zero additives.
- **Technical Specs**:
  - Moisture: <= 13.5%
  - Essential Oil Content: 2.0% to 4.5%+ (grade-dependent)
  - Admixture: <= 0.5%–1.0%
- **Export Packaging & Container Loadability**:
  - Compressed PP woven bales (20 kg / 25 kg) or FCT-branded 5-ply export cartons (10 kg / 15 kg / 20 kg)
  - 20ft GP Container: ~6.5–10 MT (sticks/tubes) or ~13–15 MT (compressed bales / powder)
  - 40ft HC Container: ~15–18 MT (cartons) or ~24–26 MT (compressed bales / powder)
  - Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): 1,000 kg (1 MT)

### 2.2 Vietnamese Star Anise (`Illicium verum` / `Hoa Hồi Lạng Sơn` / `越南大料八角`)
- **Product URL**: https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/star-anise.html
- **HS Code**: `0909.61`
- **Growing Origin**: Lang Son Karst Highlands, Northern Vietnam
- **Harvest Seasons**:
  - **Spring Harvest (`Vụ Xuân` / `春果`)**: Harvested March–April
  - **Autumn Harvest (`Vụ Thu` / `秋果` — Đại Hồi)**: Harvested August–October; large plump 8-carpels, highest essential oil & anethole concentration
- **Technical Specs**:
  - Whole Pods Ratio: >= 80%–85% intact 8-pointed stars (Grade A); Broken/Stem grades also available separately
  - Moisture: <= 12.5%–13.0%
  - Essential Oil Content: >= 8.0%–10.0%+
  - Processing: Natural sun-dried (`生晒`) or steam-treated (`蒸制`) per destination market preference
- **Export Packaging & Container Loadability**:
  - 5 kg, 10 kg, or 20 kg inner PE bag + strapped 5-ply export cartons
  - 20ft GP Container: ~6.5–7.5 MT
  - 40ft HC Container: ~14–16 MT
  - MOQ: 500 kg

### 2.3 Cinnamon Branches & Diagonal-Sliced Cinnamon Twigs (`Gui Zhi` / `桂枝片` / `桂枝丁`)
- **Product URL**: https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/cinnamon-branches.html
- **HS Code**: `0906.19`
- **Forms**:
  - Diagonal-sliced cinnamon twigs (`桂枝片`), uniform 2–4 mm slice thickness with visible natural oil ring
  - Clean cut cinnamon branch segments (`桂枝丁`), 1–3 cm segments
  - Whole dried aromatic branches (20–50 cm) for craft & natural home fragrance
- **Export Packaging**: 25 kg – 40 kg PP woven bags
- **MOQ**: 100 kg (decorative) / 1,000 kg (sliced twigs bulk)

### 2.4 Dried Vietnamese Cinnamon Leaves (`Lá Quế Khô` / `越南肉桂叶`)
- **Product URL**: https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/cinnamon-leaves.html
- **HS Code**: `0906.19` / `1211.90`
- **Applications**: Steam distillation of cinnamon leaf oil (eugenol / cinnamaldehyde), spice extraction, herbal tea blends
- **Moisture**: <= 12%
- **Packaging**: Compressed bales or bulk PP woven bags
- **MOQ**: 500 kg

### 2.5 Vietnamese Highland Whole-Leaf Green Tea (`Trà Xanh Cao Nguyên` / `越南高山绿茶`)
- **Product URL**: https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/green-tea.html
- **HS Code**: `0902.10` / `0902.20`
- **Origin**: Northern Vietnam Highlands (Thai Nguyen, Yen Bai, Phu Tho)
- **Commercial Export Grades**:
  1. **OP (Orange Pekoe)**: Whole wired curled leaf, bright green-yellow liquor, sweet honeyed finish, Total Ash <= 6.0%.
  2. **Pekoe / TH101**: Curled bold leaf, full-bodied aromatic cup, ideal for loose-leaf retail & commercial blending.
  3. **PS & BPS / Fannings**: Flaky sifted leaves (3–5 mm), rapid intense liquor extraction, high-yield base for tea bags, milk tea, and RTD beverage bottling.
- **Physical-Chemical Parameters**:
  - Moisture: <= 7.5% – 8.0%
  - Admixture: <= 0.5% – 1.0%
  - Water-Soluble Extract: >= 32% – 36% min
  - Total Ash: 4.0% – 6.5% | Crude Fiber: <= 15.5%
- **Export Packaging & Container Loadability**:
  - 20–25 kg PE-lined multi-wall Kraft paper sacks or 30–45 kg PP/PE woven bags with container desiccant poles
  - 20ft GP Container: 10–12 MT
  - 40ft HC Container: 20–24 MT
  - MOQ: 500 kg

### 2.6 Vietnamese Highland Whole-Leaf Black Tea (`Trà Đen Cao Nguyên` / `越南高山红茶`)
- **Product URL**: https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/black-tea.html
- **HS Code**: `0902.30` / `0902.40`
- **Origin**: Northern Vietnam Highland Tea Estates & Central Highlands (Bao Loc / Lam Dong)
- **Commercial Export Grades**:
  1. **Orthodox OP & FBOP (Flowery Broken Orange Pekoe)**: Dark wired whole leaves with golden tips, rich amber-red liquor, smooth honey-malt aroma.
  2. **Orthodox Pekoe / PS / BPS**: Strong robust body, rich reddish color holding exceptional strength with milk or ice.
  3. **CTC Black Tea (BP1, PF1, PD)**: Uniform high-density granular particles, instant rich infusion, maximum 40HC container payload efficiency.
- **Physical-Chemical Parameters**:
  - Oxidation: 90% – 100% full oxidation
  - Moisture: <= 7.5% – 8.0%
  - Admixture: <= 0.5% – 1.0%
  - Water-Soluble Extract: >= 32% – 38% min
  - Total Ash: 4.0% – 6.5% | Crude Fiber: <= 16.0%
- **Export Packaging & Container Loadability**:
  - 20–25 kg Multi-wall foil/PE-lined paper sacks or 25–40 kg PP/PE bags
  - 20ft GP Container: 10–13 MT
  - 40ft HC Container: 21–25 MT
  - MOQ: 500 kg

## 3. Logistics, Documentation & Buyer FAQs

- **Q: Which port does FCT Vinh Thinh ship from?**
  A: All sea freight shipments depart primarily from **Hai Phong Port, Vietnam (`VNHPH`)**, Northern Vietnam's largest deep-water international container port, via K-LINE, ONE, Evergreen, Maersk, COSCO, and SITC.

- **Q: What Incoterms and payment terms are supported?**
  A: **FOB Hai Phong**, **CFR**, and **CIF** to any global destination port. Payment via **T/T** (deposit + balance against B/L copy) or **Irrevocable L/C at sight**.

- **Q: What export documents are provided with each shipment?**
  A: Full standard customs clearance package: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Ocean Bill of Lading (B/L), Certificate of Origin (**C/O** Form B, Form D, Form E for China, Form AI for India, EUR.1 for Europe, CPTPP, RCEP), **Phytosanitary Certificate**, and **Fumigation Certificate**. Optional pre-shipment weight & quality inspection by **SGS** or **Vinacontrol** can be arranged at buyer's request.

- **Q: Can importers request product samples before placing a container order?**
  A: Yes. Representative evaluation samples (200g–500g per grade) are prepared directly from current warehouse stock and dispatched globally via DHL, FedEx, UPS, or SF Express.

- **Q: What is the typical production and container loading lead time?**
  A: **10 to 20 days** from order confirmation / deposit receipt for standard 20GP and 40HC containers.
